title: 第3章 收集物资第4章 赵敢当
slug: 永恒降临全民开局末世求生
content_zh:
【你已打开新手大礼包】
【你获得草×5，树枝×2，木头×2，软木桶钥匙×1，便携随身箱（白）×1，踏雪背包×1】
新手大礼包就是以上东西，前面三种材料可以在制作栏里面制作一些东西，其实这些东西正好就是两种光源的配方。
[草×2+树枝×2=火把×1]
[草×3+木头×2=营火×1]
前世这么多年的时间，不说全部，大部分的配方，苏墨还是记得的，选择[制作-光源]，直接选择制作火把。
【你消耗草×2、树枝×2，制作火把】
制作同样是一分钟，如果发挥自己主观能动性的话，也可以自行制作，像一些职业的专属物品，都是需要亲手制作的。
制作栏只是为了能让普通人也可以在永恒蓝星上拥有挣扎的力量。
光源在永恒蓝星上算是最重要的几样东西了，任何事物都具有两面性，「永恒领域」的夜晚，暗影能量肆虐，处于黑暗每过一分钟就会受到暗影袭击，每次袭击固定造成损失30%的血量，并且之后的袭击都将增加10%，即便有瞬间恢复，也最多抗7下，最后一次就是100%，直接秒杀。
念及于此，苏墨突然想起前世有个女子不知道通过何种方式成为了暗影女王，在永恒蓝星最后的几个阶段搅风搅雨，名字好像是叫查理。
【制作完成，你获得火把（100%）×1】
[火把（灰色）]
类别：工具光源
耐久：100%（可燃烧6小时）
装备需求：无。
装备效果：驱散暗影，照亮方圆50米。
简介：黑暗中的一束光，有了它你可以避免暗影的直接侵袭。
价格：1铜币
苏墨并没有把火把拿出来，只要拿出来就会开始计算时间，前期还是能省则省。

将剩下的材料选择[制作-光源]中的营火，材料消耗了，但由于苏墨没有选择摆放位置，所以营火并没有出现，如果将其制作出来的话，也是需要消耗一分钟的时间。
至于便携随身箱（白），就是一个16格的储物箱，可以收在储物栏中，杂七杂八的东西有点多，如果有一个空间装备的话，一些小东西就可以放在空间装备里面；踏雪背包也是一个具有8格的背包，这可是好东西，后期等级升上来的话，就相当于一个永鲜冰箱。
统计一下，一个人的储物栏有15格，背包8格，随身箱16格，不计算其他的话，苏墨此时身上有38格空闲的储物栏（随身箱占掉一个）。
环顾四周，除了几株草、树枝，还有一两棵树，就没有其他东西了。
「永恒领域」是进行的随机投放，苏墨还是跟前世一样，被投放在野外。
第一天最重要的就是搜集一些材料，明天丧尸就解除限制了，在此之前最好能把护甲和武器做出来。
苏墨径直走向旁边的草和树枝，直接选择采集，在采集的时候不能做其他事情，只能发呆或者逛联络平台。
【你开启了本地区的联络平台，填写你的代号。
（代号不能超过15字）】
苏墨思索片刻之后就填入了[玄渊]，前世，玄渊这个号给他带来了难以想象的灾难，但这又如何呢，前世如此困难都一路闯过来了，今生又怎会怯懦。
【代号完成，更改代号需要金币×5，已进入第13区联络平台，剩余发言次数：3次，次数将于每日夜晚结束之时刷新。
content_en:
[You have opened the novice gift package]
[You get grass × 5, branches × 2, wood × 2, cork barrel key × 1, portable suitcase (white) × 1, snow backpack × 1]
The novice gift package is the above things. The first three materials can be used to make some things in the production column. In fact, these things are exactly the formulas of the two light sources.
[Grass×2+Twigs×2=Torch×1]
[Grass×3+Wood×2=Campfire×1]
After so many years in his previous life, Su Mo still remembered most of the recipes, not to mention all. He chose [Production - Light Source] and directly chose to make a torch.
[You consume grass × 2 and branches × 2 to make torches]
It also takes one minute to make. If you use your own subjective initiative, you can also make it by yourself. Some professional-specific items need to be made by yourself.
The purpose of making the column is to allow ordinary people to have the power to struggle on the Eternal Blue Star.
Light sources are the most important things on the Eternal Blue Star. Everything has two sides. At night in the "Eternal Realm", shadow energy is raging. Every minute in darkness, you will be attacked by shadows. Each attack will cause a fixed loss of 30% of your health, and subsequent attacks will increase by 10%. Even if there is instant recovery, you can resist up to 7 times. The last one is 100%, which will kill you instantly.
Thinking of this, Su Mo suddenly remembered that there was a woman in the past life who somehow became the Queen of Shadows and stirred up troubles in the final stages of Eternal Blue Star. Her name seemed to be Charlie.
[The production is completed, you get the torch (100%) × 1]
[Torch (gray)]
Category: Tool Light
Durability: 100% (can burn for 6 hours)
Equipment requirements: None.
Equipment effect: Dispel shadows and illuminate a 50-meter radius.
Introduction: A beam of light in the darkness, with which you can avoid the direct invasion of shadows.
Price: 1 copper coin
Su Mo didn't take out the torch. As soon as he took it out, he would start counting the time. He could still save as much as he could in the early stage.
Select the campfire in [Production - Light Source] for the remaining materials. The materials are consumed, but because Su Mo did not choose a placement, the campfire did not appear. If it was made, it would also take a minute.
As for the portable carry-on case (white), it is a 16-grid storage box that can be stored in the storage column. There are a lot of miscellaneous things. If there is a space equipment, some small things can be placed in the space equipment. The Snow Backpack is also a backpack with 8 cells, which is a good thing. If you level up later, it will be equivalent to an eternal fresh refrigerator.
Statistics show that a person's storage slots have 15 slots, a backpack has 8 slots, and a carry-on box has 16 slots. Not counting others, Su Mo has 38 free storage slots at this time (the carry-on box occupies one).
Looking around, there was nothing but a few grasses, branches, and one or two trees.
The "Eternal Realm" was randomly released, and Su Mo was still released in the wild just like in his previous life.
The most important thing on the first day is to collect some materials. The zombie restrictions will be lifted tomorrow. Before that, it is best to make armor and weapons.
Su Mo walked straight to the grass and branches next to him and chose to collect them directly. He could not do anything else while collecting, he could only be in a daze or visit the contact platform.
[You have opened the contact platform for this region and filled in your code name.
(Codename cannot exceed 15 characters)]
After thinking for a moment, Su Mo filled in [Xuanyuan]. In his previous life, the name Xuanyuan brought him unimaginable disasters, but so what. He had overcome such difficulties in his previous life, so how could he be cowardly in this life.
[The code name is completed. Changing the code name requires gold coinsRefresh when finished.
